lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's forty-four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 44? Nope!

lines.text: Three different whole-number sides. Each one is the last, times the same multiplier.
lines.caption: 3 different whole-number sides. Each one is the last, times the same multiplier.

lines.text: The longest is two thousand twenty-five. How many triangles?
lines.caption: The longest is 2025. How many triangles?

lines.text: The sides are k squared, forty-five k, and two thousand twenty-five, with k up to forty-four.
lines.caption: The sides are k², 45k, and 2025, with k up to 44.

lines.text: The short sides must add up to more than the longest. At twenty-seven, they fall short.
lines.caption: The short sides must add up to more than the longest. At 27, they fall short.

lines.text: At twenty-eight, they make it. So does every k after!
lines.caption: At 28, they make it. So does every k after!

lines.text: Twenty-eight to forty-four. That's seventeen triangles!
lines.caption: 28 to 44. That's 17 triangles!

lines.text: Did you get seventeen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 17? Tell me below!
